__meta__.description: Missing section enrollment and how it is imputed. Summary tile: fill-source mix (own -> own_seats -> sibling_enroll -> sibling_seats -> class_median -> level_median) with raw vs assigned enrollment sums and % imputed, per class x A/B set. Middle: fill-potential (how much missing enrollment each signal could cover) and the enrollment distribution (right-skewed; feeds the class-median fallback). Bottom: coverage-fill summary and the per-section assignment detail (enrollment_assigned + enrollment_source, now persisted on master_section, #32). ~28.6% of enrollment is imputed overall and ~22% of sections take the weakest rung (class median) — gate any enrollment-weighted result on enrollment_source. seats_taken=9999 is an invalid sentinel (guarded).
